For 4743(S): A computer account was deleted.
Appendix A: Security monitoring recommendations for many audit events

Important   For this event, also see Appendix A: Security monitoring recommendations for many audit events. If you have critical domain computer accounts (database servers,
domain controllers, administration workstations, and so on) for which you need to monitor each action (especially deletion), monitor this event with the “Target
Computer\Security ID” or “Target Computer\Account Name” that corresponds to the high-value account or accounts.
